title: Our Lady of Nazareth Swim Club

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: A fun-filled camp where young children grow in their Catholic faith through Bible stories, crafts, games, music, and movement! Each day is packed with hands-on activities that help kids discover Jesus in a joyful and engaging way. MS/HS Leaders: Serve as a Faith Camp leader and make a lasting impact! Middle and high school students can share their time and talents by guiding younger campers in faith-filled activities. A volunteer application is required to ensure a meaningful experience for all. Join us for an epic week of faith, fun, and friendship! Middle schoolers will gather each evening for dinner, games, faith discussions, and fellowship. Step up as a leader and make a difference!

blurb: OLN Pool is a ministry of Our Lady of Nazareth Catholic Church and has been serving the community since 1988. Our mission is to extend the fellowship of OLN and neighboring Catholic parishes by providing a welcoming place for summer fun, swimming, and community.
